entry.title: New: Bill 20, FD1 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX B, DEPARTMENT OF WATER SUPPLY, WATER SERVICE RATES-AGRICULTURAL CONSUMERS" The purpose of this bill is to add a new category "Nondwelling Agricultural Rate" prior to Water Shortage Rates.

View on the council site
